thread:
maya: Noticing regression on viridian-v2 int8 bring-up JP ellipsis and ZWJ/ZWSP in zh are getting lost in outputs. Small repros and numbers below, cc @hiro @dai

dai: Drop repro + eval snapshot pls

maya: JP repro:
input:  
fp16: こんにちは…
int8: こんにちは… missing (token collapsed)

zh repro shows ZWSP removed between tokens -> segmentation changes

metrics (5k each): jp BLEU 32.4 -> 28.9 (-3.5), zh BLEU 35.0 -> 31.6 (-3.4), ko BLEU 29.8 -> 28.5 (-1.3), token-mismatch 0.5% -> 3.8%

hiro: Kernel selection changed (commit b4f7e). Also quantizer switched to per-tensor symmetric for embeddings in this build. Hypothesis: quant noise kills low-frequency punctuation logits.

nina: Quick mitigation: route JP/ZH/KO to q4f in canary; also try per-channel for final linear & embedding. I tested toggling detok.preserve_ellipsis=true and saw ~40% improvement but not full recovery.

dai: I'll bisect between b4f7e and prior good commit, and run a per-channel recompile tonight. If logits recover, we'll add a targeted quant-profile rule.

deploy-bot: deploy/viridian-int8-staging finished: 2026-03-22T18:02:00Z :white_check_mark:

maya: Added failing examples to regressions/onboard/viridian-int8-locales. Opening a routing PR to fallback JP/ZH/KO until fix validated.

hiro: Agreed, gate rollout until full 5k validation with per-channel pass shows <=1 BLEU delta.

dai: Will report back with bisect + per-channel numbers.
